proposition1_symmetric_lp_reduction.source_evidence: Pinned source anchor cited publication:292-316: Proposition 1. Let S be a set of recommendation policies described by finitely many linear constraints. If an optimal Problem-(2) policy rho* belongs to S and is the unique maximal-item-fairness-feasible policy in S, then rho* is recovered as the unique policy optimizer of the equality-form linear program L obtained by adding S to the constraints I_j(rho) = lambda for every item.

Under the source's equality-defined type convention, if a type-level policy is a basic feasible solution of L, at most n + K - 1 type-item coordinates are positive; if it is also optimal, at most K - 1 items are recommended with positive probability to more than one type.
